title: so…that / such…that
intro: 8 页精讲：so + 形容词/副词 + that · such + (a/an) + 形容词 + 名词 + that · 结果从句
psleNote: PSLE so/such…that 考点 58+ 处；so hot / such a hot day 易混。

examples.en: It was so hot that we stayed inside.
examples.zh: 天太热了，我们待在室内。

examples.en: He ran so fast that I couldn't catch him.
It was such a nice day that we went hiking.
examples.zh: 天气太好，我们去徒步了。

examples.en: She is so tired that she fell asleep early.
It was such good news that everyone cheered.
examples.zh: 消息太好，大家都欢呼了。

examples.en: The film was so boring that I left early.
examples.zh: 电影太无聊，我提前走了。

examples.en: He spoke so loudly that we could hear him outside.
examples.zh: 他说话太大声，外面都听得见。

examples.en: It was such an interesting story that I read it twice.
examples.zh: 故事太有趣，我读了两遍。
